At each coupled midpoint in the closed section cap at least one endpoint is in the same cap. The original two endpoint contributions therefore pay at least the midpoint contribution. The weight-two estimate gives 3Γ_{d−1}(S₀+s)/4 ≥ Γ_{d−1}(S₀+2s)/2 using s≤S₀. A purely integer cut includes the central section and at least one endpoint.

When s=0 ordinary Grünbaum applies to the proper central section in positive dimension. In d=1 the anchor section is one point and the endpoint measures have atomic masses s≤1. A through-anchor half-line attains the exact mass 1+s.

Both closed sides through the anchor pay the lower bound and count the boundary twice. Nonparallel normals cut a lower-dimensional set inside each effective fiber.
